description: The panic spills out. Keep up with Thom, then let Celia shut the whole argument down.

roles.name: Thom
roles.description: Escalate quickly. Celia’s final response stays in the scene.

by these giant robotic claws of death!

title: An old-fashioned divorce
description: Cary Grant turns a ridiculous argument into a sprint. Keep the words crisp and the logic questionable.

roles.name: Walter Burns
roles.description: Run straight through the sentence; save the emphasis for the last phrase.

cues.text: Nonsense! You've got an old-fashioned idea
divorce is something that lasts forever,
